name: Tim Kaine

issue_poll.name: Wason Center (Christopher Newport University) Virginia Survey, Sept 28 – Oct 4, 2024
issue_poll.note: Top-of-mind issue question, 800 likely voters. Foreign policy, climate and guns tied at 4% and crime and education tied at 1%; kept in poll order, so education (11th) dropped.

issues.position: Restore expanded child tax credit permanently; $17 minimum wage

votes.bill_title: FY2025 budget resolution (Sanders $17 minimum wage amendment)
votes.question: On the amendment (S.Amdt.2126)

votes.bill_title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Bennet motion to commit, child tax credit)
votes.question: On the motion to commit with instructions

issues.note: Roll call 184 Yea per Congressional Record; roll call 354 Yea per watch.vote.

issues.position: Pass the Freedom to Vote Act
issues.note: Freedom to Vote Act got no floor vote; rated on opposing the SAVE America Act's new voting requirements.

issues.position: Pass the 2024 bipartisan border bill; permanent fix for Dreamers
issues.note: Neither the bipartisan border bill nor a Dreamer pathway got a floor vote this term.

issues.position: Pass the Reproductive Freedom for All Act; oppose abortion bans

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of VA rule ending abortion services
votes.question: Motion to proceed

issues.note: Reproductive Freedom for All Act got no floor vote this term.

issues.position: Lower ACA premiums; extend $35 insulin cap to everyone

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: Insulin cap expansion got no floor vote.

issues.position: Defensive aid to Israel; no offensive weapons to the region

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of bomb sale to Israel
votes.question: Motion to discharge

issues.note: Kaine listed among Yea votes on the April 2025 Sanders resolution (JTA).

issues.position: Keep the Inflation Reduction Act's clean-energy investments

votes.bill_title: Shaheen amendment to keep clean energy credits
votes.question: On the amendment

issues.position: Universal background checks; ban assault weapons and high-capacity magazines
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on these measures found this term.

issues.position: Address inequality through education and HBCU support; no specific bill
Cited past public-safety laws; no specific forward position found

caveats: Foreign policy: JTA lists Kaine as Yea on the April 3, 2025 Sanders resolution (82-15) without naming which of roll calls 165/166; 165 recorded, needs senate.gov check.
Immigration rated No vote held; a stricter reading would test his support for more border officers against H.R.1 (Nay), as done for some other Democrats.
Economy: H.R.1 raised the child tax credit to $2,200 but did not restore the 2021 expanded credit, so it was not scored.
Votes confirmed on watch.vote (57, 72, 73, 354, 366) and the Congressional Record (184, 644); H.R.1 Nay (372) from the party-line tally; senate.gov not reachable.
